senses.definition: (countable) A domestic utensil with fibers bound together at the end of a long handle, used for sweeping.

senses.definition: (countable, curling) An implement with which players sweep the ice to make a stone travel further and curl less; a sweeper.
Any of several yellow-flowered shrubs of the family Fabaceae, with long, stiff, thin branches and small or few leaves used for the domestic utensil.
